title: Pink-haired Goblin Archer
description: Two side-by-side poses of the same female goblin character with pink hair in pigtails, wearing a small crown, dark armor with green accents, a green cape, and heavy boots. She has green spotted skin, pointed ears, and is shown in a combat stance, one with arms crossed blocking and the other blowing a green bubble while holding a fist forward.
prompt: A cartoon goblin girl with bright pink hair in high pigtails, wearing a small golden crown, green spotted skin, pointed ears, black and green armored dress, green patterned cape, black gloves and heavy boots. She stands in a dynamic combat pose against a solid green background, one view with arms crossed in an X block in front of her chest, the other view blowing a large green bubble with her fist raised, both showing a determined expression, vibrant colors, clean line art.
